messages:
maria: FYI observed a slow-growth residency on shard kv-4219 over ~48h, ended in an OOM during low traffic. Not a spike; steady accumulation.
aj: can you paste the small heap summary?
maria: total_live:+380MB over 48h. primary objects: session_blob (~115KB avg), query_cache (~30KB). fragment_ratio rose 18% -> 36%.
zara: sampled canary stacks; allocations trace to prefetch path on reconnects where TTL is skipped.
devin: sounds like "slow-residency" class. propose split: immediate guard, CI harness, and eviction design.
qa: i'll own the CI harness to simulate low-qps repeated writes to a prefix. plan: docker runner + nightly check. ETA 72h for first cut.
aj: immediate mitigation: apply per-value cap 2MB and ingress TTL enforcement behind 10% canary. maria, can you roll?
maria: opening hotfix PR and will roll to 10% canary, ETA 4h.
zara: i'll produce heap diffs & flamegraphs and tag top keys with owners. ETA 24h.
devin: medium-term: RFC for LRU-with-decay + slab compaction probe when fragment_ratio>35% for 10m. I'll draft. ETA 10d.
aj: ops alert: kv_shard_fragment_ratio>30% for 15m -> page. i'll add dashboard tiles and the alert.
qa: harness will run against PRs touching prefetch/ingest and post nightly. will add local emulator mode for contributors.
maria: acceptance gates: no recurrence for 14 days and harness shows no >200MB growth for 7 nights.
devin: add recurring "residency triage" to correlate harness failures with incidents and PRs. owner rotation proposed.
aj: all actions added to INC-4345 with owners and due dates.
maria: thanks team, checkpoint in 48h to review hotfix + harness progress.
qa: will post repo link once available.
